text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to run along the riverbank
with Silence Suzuka, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Such pleasant weather. The sun is shining so brightly—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gave me some cream, saying,
"Your skin's been acting up lately, so take care of it."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have to go back and get it.
*sigh* If only the weather were bad, UV rays wouldn't be—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If the weather's bad,
running wouldn't feel very good, would it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Silence Suzuka returned afterward,
she seemed down because her running time had been cut short.
